ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Kitab Masdur' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, 'Kitab Masdur' (the inscribed book) is often linked to the concept of divine decree or the preserved Tablet (Al-Lawh Al-Mahfuz), underscoring the permanence and clarity of revelation. This phrase highlights the tangible nature of the Quran as a definitive record, reinforcing its role as a clear guide for humanity amidst the ambiguity of other signs.
